scenes.name: THE RULER
lines: Tilt a ruler upright and ask for its slope. The calculator says: error.
把尺子立直，再问它的斜率。计算器只回一句：出错。
School names the crash infinity, and moves on.
学校给这次崩溃起名叫“无穷大”，然后接着往下讲。

chapter.zh: 前言 · 一条公理，没有无穷

scenes.name: THREE FEES
lines: Standard mathematics pays three hidden fees. First, a finished infinity.
标准数学悄悄付了三笔账。第一笔：一个已经完成、一次装满的无穷。
Second, a line where almost every point has no finite recipe.
第二笔：一条数轴，上面几乎每个点都写不出有限的配方。
Third, pi and e, reached only by endless steps.
第三笔：π 和 e，只能靠永不结束的步骤逼近。
But who sent the bill? Maybe just the habit of straight rulers.
可这账单是谁寄来的？也许这笔债，只是直尺养成的习惯。

scenes.name: BEND THE RULER
lines: Never divide. Keep a direction as two whole numbers, and bend the ruler into a ring.
干脆不做除法：把方向记成两个整数，再把尺子弯成一个圆环。
Zero, one lands on the right; one, one at the top.
[0 : 1] 落在最右边，[1 : 1] 落在最上面。
The upright ruler, one, zero, lands at minus one, zero: denominator one, not zero.
竖直的尺子 [1 : 0] 落在 (−1, 0)，分母是 1，不是 0。
Lean confirms every nonzero pair lands exactly on the circle, every upright pair at minus one.
Lean 确认：每个非零整数对都恰好落在单位圆上，每个 [p : 0] 都落在 (−1, 0)。
Infinity was never a place. It was the loose end of a ruler that never closed.
无穷大从来不是一个地方，只是一把从未合拢的尺子松开的那一端。

scenes.name: ZERO AXIOMS
lines: Read the frozen record for the strict backend. The list is empty.
翻开严格端的冻结记录，这条定理的公理清单为空。
Its numbers grow from zero and successor, like a kitchen with no pantry: all grown on the spot.
它的数从“零”和“后继”长出来，像一间没有储藏室的厨房，一切当场种出来。
Over the reals, the same circle checks too, but its proof draws on Mathlib's classical axioms.
放到实数上，同一个圆也能证，但证明要借 Mathlib 的经典公理。
The title's one axiom, AXIOM-Omega, is a contract, not a decree: the book must build what keeps it.
标题里那条公理 AXIOM-Ω 是契约，不是敕令：书得亲手造出守约的东西。

scenes.name: THE ROAD
lines: Then six volumes: numbers, rotation, change, waves on the three-sphere, primes, and a machine that watches.
接下来是六卷：数、转动、变化、三维球面上的波、素数，以及一台会观察的机器。
Stop by stop, crutches fall: infinity, pi, limits, the complex plane.
一站一站，拐杖掉下：无穷、π、极限、复平面。
The coda reads back what the kernel checked.
终章再把内核查过的账读回来。

scenes.name: FIRST STEP
lines: So we begin at the very bottom, borrowing nothing.
所以我们从最底层开始，什么都不借。
With only finite rational steps, what is a number?
只许有限步、只用有理数，数是什么？

scenes.name: FINITE MARKS
lines: Ask the machine, not the philosopher. Lean's kernel holds a zero, and one move: one more.
别问哲学家，去问机器。Lean 内核里只有一个零，和一个动作：再加一。
Every natural number is a finite stack of that move, like Lego bricks. No stack is infinitely tall.
每个自然数都是这个动作叠成的有限一摞，像乐高积木；没有哪一摞无限高。
Who promised a finished infinity? Not the kernel: no real line, no infinity sign, no pi.
谁许诺过一个“已经完成”的无穷？不是内核：没有实数轴，没有 ∞，没有 π。

chapter.en: Volume I · Foundations and homogeneous rational numbers
chapter.zh: 第一卷 · 公理地基与齐次有理数

scenes.name: THE FLOOR
lines: A classical proof here can use up to three standard axioms: choice, quotients, and propositional extensionality.
这里的经典证明最多可以用三条标准公理，即选择公理、商公理与命题外延性。
The strict library uses none of them. Equality is checked integer by integer, by a program that halts.
严格库的这项运算不依赖公理：相等逐个整数核对，由一个必定停机的程序判定。
Precision becomes a contract: one over M. Need it finer? Raise M. It is always some finite number.
精度改成一纸契约：1/M。要更细？把 M 调大。它永远是某个有限的数。
Like a camera: always more pixels, but never infinitely many in one shot.
就像相机：像素总能再加，但一张照片里永远不会有无穷多个。

scenes.name: AXIOM-Ω
lines: Now remove two more props: a privileged origin, and the plus sign. What is left?
再拆掉两根支架：特权原点，和加号。还剩什么？
Two primitives. The triad carries the step from y to x over onto z, like directions from a landmark.
两个原语。三元迁移把“从 y 到 x”这一步原样搬到 z 上，就像借地标转述路线。
And a reading, kappa: one for identical, zero for a total mismatch.
再加一个读数 κ：完全相同读 1，完全失配读 0。
Three laws: a step to yourself does nothing and steps regroup freely; carrying keeps every reading; some triple changes when its outer slots swap.
三条法则：到自己的一步什么也不做，连续的步子可以随意重组；搬运不改读数；有一组三元输入，互换外槽就会改变结果。
Pick any point as a stand-in zero, and multiplication grows back around it. No point is royalty.
任选一点临时当零，乘法就在它周围长回来；没有哪一点是王室。
The sample class lists six equations. The prototype checks examples. A full model needs proofs of all the laws.
示意类型类列出六条等式。原型核验具体算例。完整模型还须证明所有定律。

scenes.name: THE CLOSED LINE
lines: First stage, one dimension. A slope is rise over run; a vertical slope divides by zero.
第一个舞台：一维。斜率是升高除以前进，竖直的斜率就要除以零。
The usual fix bolts infinity onto the line. Instead, keep the pair: rise one, run two.
老办法是在直线两端硬接一个无穷大。我们改为保留这一对数：升 1，进 2。
Pin a string at the far side of a circle, and pull it through the mark one half.
在圆的最远端钉一根线，拉着它穿过 1/2 那个刻度。
It meets the circle at three fifths, four fifths: nine twenty-fifths plus sixteen twenty-fifths is exactly one.
Lean checks it for every integer pair except zero, zero: the point lands on the unit circle, no square root needed.
Lean 内核检验：对每一对不全为零的整数，这个点都落在单位圆上，不开一次根号。
Now the vertical slope: rise one, run zero. Every reading stays finite; it lands at minus one, zero.
再看竖直斜率：升 1，进 0。读数全部有限，它落在 (−1, 0)。
Infinity was never far away. It is the point opposite home, where the pin was.
无穷从来不在远方。它就是家对面那一点，正是钉子所在的地方。

scenes.name: ONE PLANE ONLY
lines: Points multiply as integer pairs: one-two times one-three is five-five, which is one-one.
Swap the factors, and nothing changes. The formula is symmetric in the two inputs.
交换两个因子，结果不变：公式对两个输入是对称的。
Order leaves no mark here, so the third law fails on this circle.
这个圆周模型的次序不留痕迹，所以不满足第三条法则。

scenes.name: FOUR INTEGERS
lines: Now try three-dimensional rotations. Write each projective quaternion as four integers, up to scale.
现在试试三维旋转。每条四元数射线用四个整数表示，公因子不计。
Divide out common factors, make the first nonzero entry positive: one name per ray, no quotients.
约去公因数，让第一个非零分量取正，每条射线就只有一个名字，用不着商类型。
Take two quarter turns about different axes, and compose them in both orders, like turning a book.
取绕两根不同轴的两个四分之一转，按两种顺序复合，就像翻转一本书。
One order gives one, one, one, one. The other gives one, one, one, minus one.
Lean checks that these two never share a ray. Order leaves a mark. The strict proof uses no axioms.
Lean 内核检验：两者不在同一条射线上。次序留下了痕迹。严格端证明的公理清单为空。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Yet our quaternion product has a built-in one: one, zero, zero, zero. The axiom never asked for it.
可我们的四元数乘法自带一个“1”：(1, 0, 0, 0)。公理从没要求过它。
Without an origin, how do we still multiply and turn?
没有原点，还怎么相乘、怎么转动？

scenes.name: A TRIP, NOT A SUM
lines: With no zero point, two points on a sphere cannot be added: their sum pokes out of it.
没有零点，球面上的两点就没法相加：和一加出来，就戳出了球面。
But a trip still makes sense: what took you from Paris to Rome, do again from Berlin.
但“行程”依然有意义：从巴黎到罗马走的那一段，再从柏林出发走一遍。

chapter.en: Volume II · Origin-free algebra and rational spherical geometry
chapter.zh: 第二卷 · 无原点代数与球面有理几何

scenes.name: THE HEAP
lines: Write the trip as a bracket. On flat paper it is a minus b plus c, wherever the origin sits.
把行程写成括号 [a, b, c]。在平面上它就是 a − b + c，原点放在哪里都一样。
On unit quaternions it is a times b-bar times c: whole-number arithmetic.
在单位四元数上，它是 a 乘 b 的共轭再乘 c：只用整数运算。
Lean checks the cancel laws: x, x, z gives z, and x, z, z gives x, up to scale.
Lean 内核检验两条消去律：[x, x, z] 是 z，[x, z, z] 是 x（差一个缩放）。
Order still matters: i, one, j gives k; j, one, i gives minus k.
次序依然要紧：[i, 1, j] = k，[j, 1, i] = −k。
Pick any point as home, and the bracket becomes multiply, invert, multiply. Home is a choice, not a fact.
任选一点当作家，括号就变成“乘、求逆、乘”。家是选出来的，不是天生的。

scenes.name: RELATION OF RELATIONS
lines: Now turning. Swap two directions and you get a twist; twist that against a third: the Lie triple bracket.
再看转动。交换两个方向的次序，得到一个扭转；再拿它和第三个方向比，就是利雅三元括号。
Carry a compass around a small loop on a ball: it comes back turned. The bracket records that turn.
带着指南针在球面上绕一个小圈，回来时指针转了一个角；括号记下的就是这一转。
Take u as one, one, zero, and v as one, zero, two: the bracket gives nine, and so does their squared area.
取 u = (1, 1, 0)，v = (1, 0, 2)：括号给出 9，两者面积的平方也是 9。
Lean checks this for all integer vectors: wherever the area is nonzero, the curvature is exactly one.
Lean 内核检验：任意整向量都如此。只要面积不为零，曲率就恰好是一。

scenes.name: SEVEN HUNDRED TWENTY
lines: Rotations hide a sign. The spinor one, one, one, one, over two, turns a cube by a third of a turn.
旋转里藏着一个符号。旋量 (1, 1, 1, 1; 2) 把立方体绕对角线转三分之一圈。
After three beats the cube looks home, yet the spinor reads minus one.
三拍之后立方体看上去回到原位，可旋量读出的是 −1。
Only at six beats, seven hundred twenty degrees, is it truly home. Lean checks the whole orbit.
直到第六拍、720°，它才真正回家。Lean 内核检验了整条轨道。
Like a tray turned under your arm: one turn twists the arm, the second undoes it.
就像在臂下转托盘：转一圈手臂拧住，再转一圈才解开。

scenes.name: THE CAYLEY BRIDGE
lines: Textbooks turn with e to the X, an endless series.
教科书用 e^X 转动，那是一串无穷级数。
Cut it short, and errors compound like copies of copies: in twelve steps the squared length passes two.
一截短，误差就像复印件再复印一样越积越多：十二步后长度的平方超过 2。
Cayley's fraction takes one exact step. Feed it one half, one half, zero, and out comes a matrix of thirds.
凯莱分式一步到位：代入 (½, ½, 0)，出来一个全是三分之几的矩阵。
Lean checks, for every rational input: orthogonal, determinant one, and lengths kept under repeated turns.
Lean 内核对任意有理输入都检验了：正交，行列式为一，反复转动也保长度。
Twelve turns: the denominator reaches three to the twelfth, and the length is still exactly one.
连转十二次：分母涨到 3¹²，长度仍然恰好是一。
Pi was never inside the rotation. It walks in only when we measure the turn as an angle.
π 从来不在旋转里面；只有把这一转量成角度，它才走进来。

scenes.name: CLOSING THE TRIANGLE
lines: Last, a triangle on the sphere, built from ones and zeros. One side alone has cosine one over root two.
最后，球面上一个只用 0 和 1 写成的三角形。单看一条边，余弦是 1/√2。
But walk the loop, and every corner is met twice, like hands joined in a ring: the roots square away.
可沿环路走一圈，每个顶点都恰好碰到两次，就像手拉手围成一圈：根号全都平方消掉。
The loop number B is one quarter, and one plus two B, minus the three side overlaps, is one quarter too.
环路数 B = ¼；1 + 2B 再减去三条边的重叠，也是 ¼。
Lean checks this number is never negative, and is zero when a step is doubled along a great circle.
Lean 内核检验：这个数从不为负；沿大圆把一步走两遍，它就是零。
Lift the corner off, and it is exactly one quarter. Spherical trigonometry closes in fractions.
把顶点抬离大圆，它恰好是 ¼。球面三角学用分数就能闭合。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: A heap that multiplies, a fraction that turns, a triangle that closes, all from whole numbers.
会相乘的流群，会转动的分式，会闭合的三角形，全都由整数搭成。
We can turn without π. Can we change without limits?
不用 π 也能转动。不取极限，也能变化吗？

scenes.name: SECANTS
lines: Fractions gave us rotation. But slope has always been taught with a limit.
分数已经给了我们旋转。可斜率，向来是用极限来教的。
Take x cubed at two. Divide the rise by a step h, then let h shrink.
取 x³，在 x = 2 处：用步长 h 去除升高量，再让 h 缩小。
Bishop Berkeley called such steps ghosts of departed quantities: divide by h, then call it nothing.
贝克莱主教把这种步长叫作“已死量的幽灵”：先拿 h 作除数，再说它是零。

chapter.zh: 第三卷 · 不取极限的微积分

scenes.name: ONE NEW RULE
lines: Try this instead. Add a symbol, epsilon, whose square is zero.
换个做法：添一个符号 ε，规定它的平方等于零。
Think of epsilon as a nudge you record once. A nudge of a nudge never makes the books.
把 ε 想成一笔只记一次的微小推动：推动的推动，永远不入账。
Cube two plus epsilon: eight, twelve epsilon, and leftovers with epsilon squared.
把 2 + ε 立方：得到 8、12ε，还有带着 ε² 的余项。
Those vanish. Eight is the value, twelve the slope: read off, not chased.
余项归零。8 是函数值，12 是斜率：直接读出，不必追赶。

scenes.name: KEEP THE BEND
lines: But that also throws away the bend, which lives in the square term.
可这样也把弯曲扔掉了，而弯曲恰恰住在平方项里。
So keep three slots, like a three-digit odometer: eta cubed rolls off to zero.
所以留三格，像三位数的里程表：η³ 溢出归零。
Two plus eta, cubed, is eight, plus twelve eta, plus six eta squared. Six is half the second derivative.
(2 + η)³ = 8 + 12η + 6η²。6 正是二阶导数的一半。
Value, slope and bend in one product. Lean checks the cube rule without axioms on the strict backend.
函数值、斜率、弯曲，一次乘法同时到手。Lean 在严格端无公理地检验了立方归零。

scenes.name: DIVISION ENDS
lines: Limits used to hide in division. Take one over one plus x squared, at one.
极限过去总躲在除法里。取 1/(1 + x²)，在 x = 1 处。
The jet inverse just stops, no limit needed: one half, minus one half, one quarter.
射流求逆到 η² 就自然终止，不取极限：1/2、−1/2、1/4。
A secant with step one quarter misses the slope by exactly five eighty-seconds.
步长 1/4 的割线，斜率恰好差了 5/82。
A secant is two snapshots and a guess. A jet is the speedometer.
割线是两张快照加一个猜测；射流是速度表。

scenes.name: ANY ORDER
lines: Sine and cosine were the alibi for infinity, and for pi.
正弦和余弦，一向是无穷与 π 的托辞。
Here cosine is a stream of fractions: one, minus one half, one twenty-fourth.
在这里，余弦是一串分数：1、−1/2、1/24……
Like a knitting pattern, each one is made from the one two places back. Stop at any order.
像编织图样，每一格都由往前两格的那一格织出。想停在哪一阶，就停在哪一阶。
Cosine squared plus sine squared is one in every coefficient. The strict Lean proof uses no axioms.
余弦平方加正弦平方等于 1，每个系数都成立。Lean 的严格端证明不依赖公理。

scenes.name: STAY ON THE SPHERE
lines: Now take a finite step on a sphere. Aim along the tangent at the start, and you fly off.
现在在球面上走有限的一步。按起点的切向走，就会飞离球面。
In the book's example, the squared length jumps to twenty-three ninths. Aim at the end, and it sinks.
在书中的例子里，模方跳到 23/9；按终点取向，它又往里缩。
Lean checks the drift: one minus two alpha, times the step squared. At the midpoint, that is zero.
Lean 检验了漂移：1 − 2α 乘以步长的平方。取在中点，它正好是零。
Like a seesaw, it balances only in the middle, and stays on the sphere.
像跷跷板，只有在正中才平衡：这一步留在球面上。

scenes.name: EXACT ON A COARSE GRID
lines: Integration meant slicing finer and finer. Here, summing differences along a coarse path is already exact.
积分过去意味着越切越细。在这里，沿粗糙路径把差分加起来，就已经精确。
Give each point a height; each step records its climb. Add the climbs, and the middle points cancel.
给每个点一个高度，每一步记下爬升。把爬升加起来，中间各点全部抵消。
Like a bank statement: the changes sum to closing minus opening. A round trip sums to zero.
就像银行对账单：变动加起来，等于期末减期初；走一圈回来，总和为零。
Lean checks both, for any chain and any commutative group.
Lean 对任意链、任意交换群检验了这两条。
Glue triangles, and a hand count shows only the rim survives.
三角形拼起来，手算可见：只剩外缘。

scenes.name: CURVED CAPS
lines: One idol is left: a flat plane at every point, glued with bump functions.
还剩一个偶像：每一点外挂一块平直切面，再用隆起函数粘起来。
The book's model fits small curved spheres instead: fitted caps, not a disco ball.
本书的模型改用弯曲的小球去贴：是贴合的球冠，不是迪斯科球。
We have measured along paths. Measuring a whole sphere has always needed pi.
我们已经沿着路径量过了。可要量整只球面，向来离不开 π。
If we can differentiate without limits, can we integrate without π?
不取极限能求导，不用 π 能积分吗？

scenes.name: NO PI ALLOWED
lines: We took a derivative with no limits. Now the other half: average over a curved sphere, with no pi.
上一幕不取极限就求了导。现在轮到另一半：在弯曲的球面上求平均，不许用 π。
Every textbook divides by an area full of pi. Why are we so sure it belongs there?
每本教科书都要除以一个满是 π 的面积。我们凭什么认定 π 非在那里不可？

chapter.en: Volume IV · Rational harmonics on the three-sphere
chapter.zh: 第四卷 · 三维球面上的有理谐波

scenes.name: WHOLE NOTES
lines: A wave on the three-sphere must close on itself, like a bell that rings only certain notes.
三维球面上的波必须首尾咬合，就像一口钟只能发出某些音。
So waves sort into shells. Each whole-spin shell has a character: a polynomial with integer coefficients.
于是波分成一层层的壳。每个整数自旋壳都有一个特征标：一个整系数多项式。
Its variable, kappa, is a squared overlap: an ordinary fraction.
它的变量 κ 是重合度的平方，一个普通分数。
One. Four kappa minus one. Each next shell comes from the last two by one fixed rule.
1，4κ − 1，之后每一层都由前两层按同一条规则生出来。
At kappa equals one they read one, three, five, seven: the dimension of each spin.
在 κ = 1 处，它们读出 1、3、5、7，正是每个自旋表示的维数。
Lean checks, for every whole spin and integer x, that only x squared enters. Half spins keep one root; whole spins drop it.
Lean 检验：对每个整数自旋与整数 x，只进 x²。半整数自旋留一个根号，整数自旋消掉它。

scenes.name: AVERAGE WITHOUT PI
lines: Usual calculus lets pi in as root pi on each of four axes; the area, two pi squared, takes it back out.
通常的微积分让 π 化作 √π 从四根轴各进来一次，面积 2π² 又把它拿走。
So skip the round trip: define the average of kappa to the k as a ratio of factorials.
那就省掉这趟来回：直接把 κ 的 k 次方的平均定义成阶乘之比。
Each average is the last one times a small fraction.
每个平均值都是前一个乘上一个小分数。
One, a quarter, an eighth, five sixty-fourths, seven over a hundred twenty-eight.
Lean checks that step for every k, with whole-number arithmetic.
Lean 内核对每个 k 检验了这一步，全程只用整数运算。
Pi was never inside the sphere. It was inside our ruler.
π 从来不在球里，它在我们的尺子里。

scenes.name: SHELLS AT RIGHT ANGLES
lines: Now play two shells together: multiply their characters and average.
现在让两层壳一起响：把特征标相乘，再求平均。
Shell one with shell two: five, minus eight, plus four, minus one. Exactly zero.
第一层配第二层：5 − 8 + 4 − 1，恰好是 0。
Shell two with itself: fourteen, minus thirty, plus twenty-two, minus six, plus one. Exactly one.
Different shells sit at right angles, like north and east.
不同的壳彼此垂直，就像北和东。
Lean checks this table, and every pair of whole spins: one on the diagonal, zero elsewhere.
Lean 内核检验了这张表，也检验了所有整数自旋对：对角线上是 1，其余全是 0。

scenes.name: A ROOT AS A PAIR
lines: Some roots do force their way in: to make one, one, zero, zero a unit, you need root two.
有些根号确实挤得进来：要把 (1, 1, 0, 0) 缩成单位长，就需要 √2。
Must we swallow the real line for one number? No. Keep a pair of fractions, and one rule: delta squared is two.
为了一个数就得吞下整条实数轴吗？不必。记一对分数，再加一条规则：δ² = 2。
A square root is just an IOU with one rule for cashing it.
平方根不过是一张欠条，附一条兑现规则。
Two root two, the quantum ceiling in Bell's game, is the pair zero, two. Lean checks its square is exactly eight.
2√2 是贝尔游戏的量子上限，即数对 (0, 2)。Lean 检验：它的平方恰为 8。

scenes.name: A FLOOR YOU CAN CHECK
lines: Last tool: is a quadratic form positive? Textbooks hunt eigenvalues, here full of root seventeen.
最后一件工具：一个二次型是不是正的？教科书去找特征值，这里满是 √17。
Instead, hold x fixed and walk along y. The form is a valley.
换个办法：固定 x，沿着 y 走。这个二次型是一道山谷。
Its floor sits at y equals minus two thirds x, at height four thirds x squared. So Q is positive, using only fractions.
谷底在 y = −⅔x，高度是 ⁴⁄₃x²。所以 Q 是正的，用的全是分数。
Lean checks this for every positive pivot: nothing dips below the floor, and the floor is reached right there.
Lean 内核对一切正主元检验：没有一点低于谷底，而谷底恰在那一点取到。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Whole notes, fractional averages, a floor checked by hand: harmonics with no pi and no limits.
整数的音阶，分数的平均，一个手算核对的谷底：没有 π、没有极限的谐波。
The sphere has its harmonics. Do the primes have theirs?
球面有它的谐波。素数也有吗？

scenes.name: NO LAST PRIME
lines: The sphere rang with harmonics. Before the primes sing, a plainer question: why do they never run out?
球面奏出了谐波。在请素数开口之前，先问一件更朴素的事：素数为什么永远用不完？
We picture every prime already queued at the far end of the number line. Who has ever seen that queue?
我们总以为，全体素数早已排好队，等在数轴的尽头。可谁真的见过这支队伍？

chapter.en: Volume V · Primes without the complex plane
chapter.zh: 第五卷 · 不借复平面的素数

scenes.name: EUCLID'S ESCAPE
lines: Euclid gives a recipe instead: multiply a finite list of primes, then add one.
欧几里得给的不是队伍，而是一道菜谱：把有限个素数乘起来，再加一。
Two through thirteen gives thirty thousand and thirty-one. Every listed prime leaves remainder one.
取 2 到 13，得到 30031。清单上每个素数去除它，都余 1。
Yet it is fifty-nine times five hundred and nine. Fifty-nine was never on the list.
可它并不是素数：30031 = 59 × 509。而 59 从来不在清单上。
Lean checks this for any list of positive whole numbers: product plus one has a prime factor off the list.
Lean 内核对任何正整数清单都检验了：乘积加一，总有一个不在清单上的素因子。
Infinity is not a warehouse. It is a rule that never runs dry.
无穷不是一座仓库，而是一条永不枯竭的规则。

scenes.name: FRACTIONS THAT STOP
lines: The same division on a fraction always stops: forty-three thirtieths unfolds as one, two, three, four.
同样的辗转相除用在分数上，总会停下：43/30 展开成 [1; 2, 3, 4]。
Lean checks that neighbouring convergents cross-multiply to plus or minus one, so none ever needs reducing.
Lean 内核检验了：相邻渐近分数交叉相乘恰得 ±1，所以没有哪一个还需要约分。

scenes.name: ONE RULER PER PRIME
lines: Now measure one number with many rulers: the usual one, and one more for every prime.
现在用很多把尺子量同一个数：一把普通的尺，再给每个素数各配一把。
The p ruler counts only factors of p, and each one shrinks the reading p times.
p 号尺只数因子 p：每多一个 p，读数就缩小为 1/p。
Minus thirty-five eighteenths reads thirty-five eighteenths, then two, nine, a fifth, and a seventh.
Multiply the readings: exactly one. Lean checks this for every nonzero rational number.
把读数全部乘起来：恰好是 1。Lean 内核对每个非零有理数检验了这本账。
What the usual ruler stretches, the prime rulers together take back.
普通尺拉长的，素数尺合起来如数收回。

scenes.name: A PRIME BECOMES A TURN
lines: Numbers commute. Turns in space do not. Can a prime become a turn?
数的乘法可以交换次序，空间里的转动却不行。素数能变成转动吗？
One plus two i, times one minus two i, is exactly five.
Put the two on i, j or k, with either sign: six whole quaternions. Lean checks each has squared length five.
让 ±2 落在 i、j 或 k 上：得到六个整四元数。Lean 内核检验了：每个的模方都是 5。
Each is an exact turn about an axis, with cosine minus three fifths. No pi needed.
每一个都是绕坐标轴的精确转动，余弦是 −3/5。用不着 π。

scenes.name: A TREE WITH NO LOOPS
lines: Chain the six turns, never undoing the last one. Can a chain ever come home?
把六个转动串起来，只是不许立刻撤回上一步。这串转动能回到原点吗？
Six chains, then thirty, then a hundred and fifty: five fresh choices at every step.
先是 6 串，然后 30 串，再然后 150 串：每一步都有 5 个新选择。
Lean checks: two such chains that move the x and y axes alike are the same chain.
Lean 内核检验了：两串这样的转动，若把 x 轴和 y 轴搬到同样的位置，它们就是同一串。
Like branches of a tree, no two twigs ever grow back together. The six turns generate a free group.
就像树枝：分出去的细枝，再也不会长回一起。这六个转动生成了一个自由群。

scenes.name: A GAP WITHOUT ROOTS
lines: Let the canonical six turns stir a mean-zero pattern on the rotation group, like a spoon in coffee. How fast do swirls fade?
让规范六枚旋转搅动旋转群上的零均值花纹，就像勺子搅咖啡。漩涡消得有多快？
Textbooks bound this with two root five and complex numbers. Square it, and the roots vanish.
教科书用 2√5 和复数来给出这个界。两边一平方，根号就消失了。
The test becomes: twenty minus lambda squared is never negative.
判据变成：20 − λ̂² 永不为负。
The simplest swirl, chi one, comes back as minus two fifths of itself, at every point. Lean checks it.
最简单的漩涡 χ₁，搅一次就回到自身的 −2/5 倍，处处如此。Lean 内核检验了这一点。
At three, one, minus two, four: chi is one fifth, and the stir gives minus two twenty-fifths.

The margin, four ninety-six over twenty-five, is positive, as Lean checks. The constant fails. The L P S result covers every nonconstant rotation-group shell, the positive even degrees on the three-sphere.
裕度 496/25 > 0，Lean 已检验；常值超出此界；LPS 的文献界覆盖旋转群所有非常值壳层，即三维球面上的正偶次壳层。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: The Riemann hypothesis asks a cousin of this bound, for the zeros of zeta. An external Lean project proved it; this book has not frozen it.
黎曼猜想问的是这个界的“表亲”，对象是 ζ 的零点。它已由外部 Lean 项目证明；本书没有冻结它。
Primes escape, rulers balance, turns never loop, and the gap needs no square root.
素数会逃逸，尺子能配平，转动不成环，谱隙不要根号。
Numbers, turns, calculus, spectra: can one machine run them all?
数、转动、微积分、谱：一台机器能全跑起来吗？

scenes.name: A WORLD OF FRACTIONS
lines: So far, everything has been a fraction. What kind of computer could live in such a world?
到目前为止，一切都是分数。在这样的世界里，能住下什么样的计算机？
Who said it needs chips, memory and a clock? One whole number and a list of fractions will do.
谁说计算机非得有芯片、内存和时钟？一个整数加一串分数，就够了。

chapter.en: Volume VI · Computation, observers and the zero-axiom kernel
chapter.zh: 第六卷 · 计算、观察者与零公理内核

scenes.name: ONE RULE
lines: This is Conway's FRACTRAN. Multiply your number by the first fraction that keeps it whole.
这是康威的 FRACTRAN：用表中第一个能让它保持整数的分数，去乘你的数。
Then go back to the top. When no fraction fits, the machine stops.
然后回到表头。哪个分数都不合适时，机器就停下。
Picture each prime as a jar of marbles. Your number says how many sit in each jar.
打个比方：每个素数是一只弹珠罐，你的数说出每只罐里有几颗。
Three quarters means: take two marbles from jar two, drop one into jar three.
四分之三的意思是：从 2 号罐取走两颗，往 3 号罐放进一颗。

scenes.name: FIFTEEN STEPS
lines: Start at two to the seventeenth: seventeen marbles in jar two.
从 2 的 17 次方出发：2 号罐里有十七颗弹珠。
Pairs of twos become threes, pairs of threes become fives, then sevens, then elevens.
两颗 2 换一颗 3，两颗 3 换一颗 5，再往上换成 7，换成 11。
Fifteen steps later the number is twenty-two, and nothing divides it. The machine halts.
十五步之后，数变成 22，再没有分母能整除它。机器停机。
Seventeen is sixteen plus one: sixteen twos climbed to the top, one stayed behind.
17 = 16 + 1：十六颗 2 一路爬到顶，剩下一颗留在原地。
Lean's kernel checked every step, and that the first halt comes at step fifteen. Zero axioms on the strict backend.
Lean 内核逐步查过这条轨迹，证实第十五步首次停机。严格端公理为空。

scenes.name: ORDER MATTERS
lines: But one number has a blind spot. Three times five is five times three.
可是一个数有盲区：三乘五等于五乘三。
It counts what happened, not the order. Socks then shoes is not shoes then socks.
它记得发生了什么，记不住先后。先穿袜再穿鞋，和先穿鞋再穿袜，不是一回事。
So bring in the turns of Volume Two: a quaternion, four whole numbers that multiply like turns and stretches.
于是把第二卷的转动请进机器：四元数，四个整数坐标，乘起来像转动加伸缩。
X times Y and Y times X have the same size, twenty-five, yet point different ways.
X 乘 Y 与 Y 乘 X 模方相同，都是 25，指向却不同。
One gate divides by five. The first passes cleanly; the second leaves remainders and is blocked.
一道闸门除以 5：前者干净通过，后者留下余数，被挡在门外。
Lean checks this split without axioms on the strict backend. A number remembers how much. A turn remembers when.
这一分离经 Lean 检查，严格端公理为空。数记得多少，转动记得先后。

scenes.name: WHO RUNS IT
lines: Now turn the camera around. Who is running this machine?
现在把镜头掉转：是谁在运行这台机器？
The book's model is an observer with no outside: all it can ever receive is already within.
本书的模型是一位没有外部的观察者：它能接收的一切，早已在它之内。
Its time is not a wall clock, but how much genuinely new structure it has absorbed.
它的时间不是墙上的钟，而是它真正吸收了多少新结构。
Like a diary: a day with nothing new written adds no page. A first comparison adds no cycle. The next closes a triangle. The readings are zero, one half, and two.
就像日记：一天没写下新东西，就不添一页。第一条比较边未增环路，下一拍闭合三角形。读数依次为 0、1/2、2。
That is an interpretation, so it wears purple, not green.
这是诠释，所以它用紫色，不用绿色。

scenes.name: THE JUDGE
lines: Last comes the judge: Lean's kernel, a small program that checks every step of every proof.
最后登场的是裁判：Lean 内核，一个小程序，逐步检查每个证明的每一步。
The strict library skips official Init. Its selected import closures replay in an empty kernel.
严格库不导入官方 Init。选定的导入闭包在空内核中重放。
Every point this formula builds from two integers, not both zero, lands exactly on the circle. Axiom list on the strict backend: empty.
两个不全为零的整数经公式造出的点恰在圆上。严格端公理清单为空。
The real numbers live outside, past a one-way bridge. There the same circle reappears, at a price.
实数住在外面，隔着一座单向桥。过了桥，同一个圆重新出现，但要付代价。
The price is Mathlib's classical axioms, and nothing ever flows back. Proof inside, shadow outside.
代价是 Mathlib 的经典公理，而且什么都不会流回来。证明在里，影子在外。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: A machine, an observer, and a judge that brings no axioms of its own.
一台机器，一位观察者，和一位自己不带一条公理的裁判。
So what, in the end, did the kernel check?
说到底，内核查过了什么？

scenes.name: THE AUDIT
lines: Six volumes in, which lines did the kernel actually sign?
六卷走完，内核真正签了字的是哪几行？
Think of an audit: each line gets a stamp naming its guarantor.
把它当成一次审计：每一行盖一个章，写明由谁担保。
Green: the Lean kernel checked it. Purple: our reading. Red: nobody knows yet.
绿章：Lean 内核查过；紫章：我们的解读；红章：至今没人知道。

chapter.zh: 终章 · 内核查过的账

scenes.name: PRELUDE TO VOLUME III
lines: Prelude. Only a promise: no infinity, no extra axioms. No green stamp yet.
前言：只是一句承诺——没有无穷，不加公理。先不盖绿章。
Volume one. Two to three reads like four to six, and infinity, one to zero, lands at minus one.
第一卷：2:3 与 4:6 读数相同；从前的“无穷远点” 1:0，落在圆上的 −1 处。
Volume two. A rational vector builds a matrix whose transpose is exactly its inverse.
第二卷：一个有理向量造出一个矩阵，它的转置恰好就是逆。
Volume three. Eta cubed is zero, so the chain rule is two lines of fractions. No limit taken.
第三卷：η 的三次方为零，链式法则就是两行分数运算，不取极限。

scenes.name: VOLUMES IV TO VI
lines: Volume four. Averaged over the three-sphere with no pi, the even characters are orthonormal in every degree.
第四卷：在三维球面上求平均，不用 π，各阶偶次特征标照样正交归一。
Volume five. Multiply the primes up to thirteen, add one: out falls fifty-nine, not on the list.
第五卷：把 13 以内的素数乘起来再加 1，掉出一个不在名单上的 59。
Volume six. A four-rule machine halts at twenty-two after fifteen steps, never sooner.
第六卷：四条规则的机器走十五步停在 22，一步也不早。

scenes.name: THE TALLY
lines: Each D5 theorem shown here has two records. Its strict axiom list is empty. Its official dependencies are recorded separately.
画面所列各条 D5 定理都有两套记录。严格端的公理清单为空，官方端的依赖另有记录。
Outside the wall, eleven bridge theorems cast shadows onto the classical numbers. One way only.
墙外，十一条桥接定理把影子投到经典数系上；只出不进。

scenes.name: PURPLE AND RED
lines: Purple is not faded green. The observer as the universe is a model we chose, not a theorem.
紫色不是褪了色的绿。“观察者即宇宙”是我们选定的模型，不是定理。
Red stays red: Einstein's equations from finite comparisons, and Ramanujan bounds in higher rank.
红色仍是红色：由有限比较推出爱因斯坦方程，以及高秩群上的拉马努金界。
Why did we think we needed infinity? Habit: curves on flat paper, paid for with polygons that never stop doubling.
我们凭什么以为离不开无穷？习惯。在平直的纸上画曲线，再用不停加倍的多边形去还账。

scenes.name: RECEIPT
lines: Behind every green stamp, the kernel checked every step of the proof.
每个绿章背后，证明的每一步都经内核检查。
We did not tame infinity. We simply stopped borrowing it.
我们没有驯服无穷。我们只是不再向它借债。
